name: 召唤法阵
description: Gacha dictionary, class pools and pet collection. Second small domain migrated out of api/modules/**. Adopts three pre-existing tables (pet_dictionary, gacha_pools, student_pets) rather than renaming them, because admin.repository.ts deletes two of them by legacy name and the rows are returned to the frontend as-is. Student points are spent through classroom.public.transferStudentCredits and the draw is written to the shared ledger through classroom.public.recordStudentLedgerEntry.

data._adopted_note: All three keep their legacy names: `SELECT *` rows from pet_dictionary/gacha_pools/student_pets are returned straight to the frontend (rarity, cost_points, ssr_rate, instance_id, is_active are the JSON contract), and api/modules/admin/admin.repository.ts still deletes gacha_pools and student_pets by name in its user/class cascade. Renaming them is a coordinated frontend + admin change, tracked as namespace debt by guardrail G10.
data._known_debt: 1. AUTHORIZATION, closed this round: all ten `/api/gacha` routes were reachable with no credential at all - anonymous callers could draw for any student (spending their points), read any student's collection, change any student's active pet, add dictionary entries that feed every class's pool, and read (creating on first read) any class's pool and odds. Every route now resolves the caller from the kernel's verified request context via `src/gacha.authorization.ts` (401 `未登录或登录已过期` before any validation message; 403 `无权限执行该操作` for a known caller without the role), and the service narrows the subject through the classroom port (`src/gacha.service.ts`, the "actor scope" section): draws and active-pet writes are student-self, collection reads are student-self / linked parent / the student's class teacher / admin, class pools are the class's teacher and students, and dictionary writes are teacher/admin. `GET /api/gacha/dictionary` is the one route the matrix leaves to "anyone (public content) or a logged-in user"; it now requires a session (the P3 reading: at least require a login) and stays open to every role. The `auth: "actor"` declarations in `provides.routes` below were aspirational until this round; they are now accurate. 2. `GachaService.listPools` creates the default pool on first read - a GET that writes - so the class membership check runs before it; the create-on-empty itself is preserved because two concurrent first reads must not both insert. 3. NOT done, deliberately: no `ctx.permissions` capability (e.g. `gacha.draw`) is declared; the matrix rules on roles. 4. `draw` still passes `actorId: 0` into `classroom.public.transferStudentCredits`, exactly as the pre-migration code did.
